title: ABODA abandoned-object videos
license_notes: No dataset license located in the author repository; public download is not a license grant.
purpose: Unattended-item video evidence; project review required for event timing.

title: CAVIAR INRIA selected videos and XML
license_notes: Author page explicitly states CC BY-SA without a version. Acknowledge EC Funded CAVIAR / IST 2001 37540.
purpose: Eight selected sequences; object presence alone is not an unattended state.

title: Stanford 40 Actions
license_notes: Author page requests citation; no explicit dataset license located in the saved page. The Hugging Face mirror does not establish original rights.
purpose: 40 action classes, 9,532 images. Smoking and action confusers; acquired primary archives and one independent mirror archive.

title: MIVIA Illegal Waste Dumping Dataset
license_notes: No explicit data license located in the author repository. The Drive host does not determine licensing.
purpose: Littering/dumping videos and event annotations. 500 listed videos; 498 acquired. Study partitions contain 435 after source-relationship exclusion.

title: Street Scene (selected frames and track annotations)
license_notes: Author Zenodo release lists CC BY-SA 4.0.
purpose: RGB loitering proxy from published tracks and anomaly types. Supervised research re-split of original Test videos; not the official benchmark.

title: Smoker Detection image classification dataset
license_notes: Kaggle API licenseName verified and saved in dataset_evidence/kaggle_terms_20261020.json; uploader declaration.
purpose: Smoking image transfer set; not independent CCTV evidence.

title: RS-WACV24 thermal loitering trajectories
license_notes: MIT is the repository license. Separate original sensor-data rights are not documented; this entry covers the published CSV repository files, not arbitrary raw thermal videos.
purpose: 19,737 trajectories; 17,878 eligible. Single thermal camera over 31 dates; separate modality study, not RGB CLIP training.

title: Wikimedia Commons / original Flickr photographs
license: per-file (CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / CC0 / public domain / other)
license_notes: Each file has its own original author, source page, license URL, usage terms and restrictions in its manifest and docs/commons_attribution.csv. No blanket license applies. Candidate collection is larger than the reviewed training subset.
purpose: Apparently sleeping/resting people and controls. Project proxy labels do not establish housing status; most acquired candidates are not training examples.

title: HMDB51 original action archive
license_notes: Original Brown download URL retained. No explicit current data license verified; underlying movie/Internet sources may retain rights. Do not infer a license from third-party mirrors.
purpose: Seven extracted confuser/smoking classes, 906 clips; downloaded archive includes all 51 classes. The fetcher retrieves the archive only.
instructions: Extract the selected classes with scripts/extract_hmdb_sources.py after acquisition.

title: MEVA abandon-package video subset
license_notes: Official MEVA page states all data are CC BY 4.0. Cite the MEVA dataset paper; source video and annotation provenance retained.
purpose: 13 acquired videos of 14 annotation matches. Abandon-package actions are distinct from persistent unattended states.

title: AVSS 2007 abandoned-baggage pilot (AODsurvey bundle)
license_notes: Redistribution bundle contains AVSS footage and separate code. No explicit footage license verified. A code license would not establish video licensing.
purpose: Three EASY/MEDIUM/HARD videos plus original annotations. Data extraction only; downloaded source code is never executed.

title: Author small-item video component
license_notes: No explicit dataset license verified in author release. Three highway/debris clips serve as a component probe. Bundled ABODA aliases are not independent data.
purpose: Item/owner component investigation; not a full unattended-baggage benchmark.

title: XRF55 RGB Public (selected scene/subject pilot)
license_notes: The public release README specifies CC BY-NC 4.0. Kaggle says Other (specified in description). Repository code licensing is separate.
purpose: 740 selected five-second RGB clips (886,570,077 bytes) from the 43.36 GB release; smoking gesture plus phone/drink/eat controls. Weak action labels, not verified cigarette visibility.

title: D2-CDNet foreground segmentation (metadata only)
license_notes: The mirror README declares Apache-2.0. The repack contains CDnet-derived material; original CDnet terms are separate and not established by the mirror declaration.
purpose: Metadata fetched; optional multi-GB shards are auxiliary masks, not anomaly event labels.

title: Original shared Drive corpus
license_notes: An aggregation, not a single licensed dataset. Preserve component export notices. Some subsets are synthetic, object-only or lack reliable event labels.
purpose: Initial smoking, littering, loitering, rough-sleeping and unattended-item folders; 19,678 listed file entries in the original receipt. Listing and retrieval remain dynamic in the existing concurrent Drive downloader.
